Hi Kelsey,

I just got off the line with Tiana from the office, and Darrell.
This time round they were able to show me the issues theyve been experiencing.

Soon after starting an FMX template / series in Sidexis x-rays will stop being produced after the sensor is exposed.

Behaviors observed:
Moving the sensor to thinner anatomical regions produced x-rays
Increasing pulse count / exposure time on their x-ray device resulted in some success depending on tooth #
Taking x-rays of test objects (paper / bib clips) works consistently, 4 FMX templates  (72 total images) were acquired without fail
Problem only occurs when acquiring x-rays of patients in the chair

The x-ray source being used in their room is a Gendex GX770 - an older device discontinued in 2010.
These devices may be the source of ongoing issues, specifically with their tube head output and whether or not its able to penetrate certain levels of anatomy to capture the image.

When there is not material between the tube head and sensor, we can take x-rays all day long.
As soon as a patient is between the sensor and tube head, it has trouble generating an image based on the region.

Theres a few options we have to narrow the problem down further.
Verify the output of the Gendex tube head using a dosimeter
There may be another x-ray device of another make / model in another room (this still needs to be verified) where their main computer could be moved too for testing purposes
Bring a loaner / temporary mobile x-ray source (either cart configuration, or handheld) for testing / confirmation

With all of these options, this would require a Patterson tech on site.
Ive spoken with Jonathan over the phone after my remote session for the update, and to discuss the next steps.

If we can get both a dosimeter out there and/or a known working loaner x-ray source, that would be ideal.
Let me know.

Thanks
Warm Regards,
